title: Kitne Door Kitne Paas
desc: After studying in New York City, Jatin (Fardeen Khan) is returning home to India, where he's set to marry a woman from his hometown. On his flight to Delhi, he meets Karishma (Amrita Arora), coincidentally on her way to her own marriage, and her quick temper instantly sets them at odds. Once in Delhi, the unlikely travel companions find their connecting flight has been cancelled, so Jatin and Karishma must share a long bus ride to Gujarat, discovering each other and themselves in the process.

title: Once Upon Time In Mumbai Doobara
desc: A gripping gangster film set in a world of crime and deceit. The story follows the battle for control of Mumbai between notorious gangster Shoaib and ambitious youth Aslam, as they navigate love, loyalty, and betrayal. With explosive action and unforgettable characters, this high-stakes journey takes you deep into the heart of the criminal underworld, where only the strongest will emerge victorious.

title: Kisaan
desc: The story of a farmer, Maan Singh, who struggles to save his ancestral land from corrupt officials and greedy businessmen. With the help of his son, he fights against the system and stands up for his rights as a farmer. The movie highlights the challenges faced by farmers in modern India and explores themes of family, tradition, and social justice in a poignant and inspiring plot.

title: Ilaka (peddupettai)
desc: Crime drama about Kumar, a man who rises from a slum to become a powerful figure in the underworld after witnessing his mother's murder. Driven by ambition and vengeance, he navigates betrayal and crime.
